a.description: an object that is convertible to an array. This includes JAX arrays, NumPy arrays, Python scalars, Python collections like lists and tuples, objects with a ``__jax_array__`` method, and objects supporting the Python buffer protocol.

dtype.description: optionally specify the dtype of the output array. If not specified it will be inferred from the input.

copy.description: optional boolean specifying the copy mode. If True, then always return a copy. If False, then error if a copy is necessary. Default is None, which will only copy when necessary.

device.description: optional :class:`~jax.Device` or :class:`~jax.sharding.Sharding` to which the created array will be committed.

output.description: A JAX array constructed from the input.
